name: Backpacked Backpack

pages.text: Equip and open with your current backpack key; slots and configuration remain native.

pages.title: Carrying
pages.text: Craft through JEI, equip through native controls and use your currently assigned backpack key. Consult Controls for the current binding; it may have been changed.

pages.title: Slots and augments
pages.text: Locked slots show costs in the menu. Spend storage tokens from the cursor. Augment bays, model selection and extra equipped-backpack slots have separate rules and costs; one token does not replace them all.

pages.title: Placing
pages.text: Use a native shelf or dock to place a filled backpack. Its contents and progress stay on the backpack; check which particular pack is open before exchanging it.

jem_summary: Equip and open with your current backpack key; slots and configuration remain native.
